newsitem.title: UK: ICI declines comment on other disposals.
newsitem.headline: ICI declines comment on other disposals.

text.p: Imperial Chemical Industries Plc said on Wednesday it would not comment on candidates for disposal other than its Tioxide unit and ICI Australia.
ICI, announcing the $8 billion purchase of speciality chemicals units from Unilever NV /Plc, said it expected to raise three billion stg from disposals over three years.
The disposals include a global offering of its stake in ICI Australia Ltd, which ICI chief executive Charles Miller Smith said was valued at around one billion stg based on Tuesday's share prices.
ICI has previously announced it plans to sell its Tioxide pigment business, estimated at around 1.5 billion stg.
But Miller Smith declined to name which other operations the group intended to sell.
"We are not commenting on the other disposal candidates," he told Reuters.
